# ZekoraPay

> ZekoraPay is a global financial platform for Africa: multi-currency wallets, instant transfers, prepaid cards, currency exchange, QR-code merchant payments, digital tontines/associations, enterprise accounts, an online shop, donation campaigns, event ticketing, a cash-in/cash-out agent network, video meetings and an AI assistant — all in one web app.

The web app is live today at https://app.zekorapay.com. Mobile apps are not yet published.

## Product

- [Home](https://zekorapay.com/): overview of the platform and its 13 core features
- [About](https://zekorapay.com/about): mission, values, team
- [Features](https://zekorapay.com/#features): detail page for each feature (wallets, transfers, cards, exchange, QR payments, tontines, enterprise, shop, donations, events, agents, meetings, AI assistant)

## User guide

- [Guide](https://zekorapay.com/guide): how to use the app, step by step, with real screenshots — account creation & KYC, wallets, transfers, cash deposits/withdrawals, currency conversion, cards, merchant payments, tontines & associations, events & ticketing, the enterprise module, rentals & real estate, the shop, donations, video meetings, and becoming an agent.

## Developer API

- [API documentation](https://zekorapay.com/docs): public REST API for third-party integrations — authentication (API keys, scopes, rate limits), wallets, merchant payments, exchange, shop, donations, events, cards, users, and webhooks. Base URL: `https://api.app.zekorapay.com/public-api-gateway/v1`.
